subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Students only wrote big things, like helping someone who fell down.”?
options: It also helped the teacher see what silence had hidden.
They also learned that kindness needs thought.
Then the teacher explained that small kindness also counted.
Their teacher explained that seeds can protect food diversity.
